card.name: Partway through words in aminoglycoside warnings
card.fires_on: Responds to a piece inside a longer word or number, mostly in aminoglycoside label warnings (nephrotoxicity, contraindications, sensorineural, fetal harm). It also fires on the middle digit of numbers such as 10 days or 1970s.

modes.label: Inside toxicity and warning words
modes.description: Early or middle part of long medical words in warning text, where the rest of the word comes next.

modes.label: Digits inside numbers
modes.description: A digit that is followed by another digit in a duration or a decade.

modes.label: Word before harm
modes.description: The word fetal after can cause, in pregnancy warnings.
modes.example: can cause<< fetal>> harm when administered to a pregnant woman.
